audit.action.node_sharing_updated.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: changed its sharing rule.

audit.action.node_trashed.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb before an item name: moved to the trash.

audit.action.share_link_created.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: created a link to.

audit.action.share_link_revoked.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: turned off a link to.

audit.action.tag_attached.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: added a tag to.

audit.action.tag_detached.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: removed a tag from.

audit.action.tenant_created.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: created the space.

audit.action.tenant_updated.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: changed the space settings.

audit.action.version_created.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: saved a new version of.

audit.action.version_labeled.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: named a version of.

audit.action.version_restored.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase before an item name: restored a version of.

Verb phrase: an agent key was refused; the select gives the reason (key turned off, key ended, agent paused, access ended). Glossary: a key is "turned off" and "ends", never "revoked" or "expired".

audit.agent.keyUsed.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: an agent used its agent key (glossary: "key", never "API key" alone).

audit.agent.token.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: an agent signed in and started working (same as audit.action.agent_token_issued; never "token" on screen).

audit.anItem.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Stand-in for an item whose name Ruum cannot show, inside a sentence.

audit.appPassword.used.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: connected with the app password {name}.

audit.appPassword.used.unknown.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: connected with an app password whose name is gone.

audit.auth.firstUse.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: opened the space {space} for the first time after a new sign-in (never "session" as a noun on screen).

audit.auth.login.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: signed in.

audit.auth.logout.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: signed out.

audit.client.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Client facts: {ip} is an IP address, {agent} the browser or program. Keep the "·" separator.

audit.client.browserOn.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Browser on an operating system, for example "Firefox on macOS". {browser} and {system} are product names.

audit.everyone.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Object: everyone in the space {space}.

audit.filter.all.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Filter option: show every event.

audit.filter.auth.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Filter option: show only sign-ins.

audit.filter.links.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Filter option: show only events about links.

audit.grant.added.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: gave {who} {role} access to {item}. {role} is an inline role word (view, edit...).

audit.grant.added.mayJoin.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: shared {item} with {who}, who may join as a guest. {role} is an inline role word.

audit.grant.removed.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: removed the {role} access of {who} to {item}.

audit.grant.updated.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: changed the access of {who} to {item} from {old} to {new} (inline role words).

audit.link.created.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: created a link to {item}.

audit.link.revoked.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: turned off a link to {item}.

audit.member.removed.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: removed {who} from the space.

audit.member.viaEmailGrant.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: joined as a guest through one or more shares; {who} is the first sharer, {more} how many others.

audit.none.text.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Empty state text. {space} is the space name.

audit.none.title.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Empty state title.

audit.refused.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Badge on an event that Ruum refused.

audit.role.changed.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: changed the role of {who} from {old} to {new} (inline member role words).

audit.role.changed.unknown.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: changed the role of {who}, old and new role unknown.

audit.role.comment.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Inline role word inside an activity line: comment.

audit.role.edit.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Inline role word inside an activity line: edit.

audit.role.manage.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Inline role word inside an activity line: manage.

audit.role.some.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Inline role word when the role is unknown: some (access).

audit.role.view.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Inline role word inside an activity line: view.

audit.rule.inherit.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Value of a sharing rule inside a sentence: same as the folder above.

audit.rule.no.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Value of a sharing rule inside a sentence: no.

audit.rule.yes.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Value of a sharing rule inside a sentence: yes.

audit.sharing.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Verb phrase: changed the sharing rule of {item} from {old} to {new}.

audit.show.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Button: show more facts of an event.

audit.signIns.help.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Helper text of the sign-in filter.

audit.text.colon.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Pattern of a line where the object follows a colon: {verb}: {object}. Change only the punctuation if your language needs it.

audit.text.joined.description: Activity log of the space (Space settings): one line per event, "<who> <verb phrase> <object>". Neutral and exact: it is a security record. Pattern of a line where the object follows the verb: {verb} {object}. Change only the order if your language needs it.

compare.same.description: Compare versions view of a file (Versions panel). Result when two versions are the same. Light.

connect.app.flow.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. How the connection works, after the steps.

connect.app.intro.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Intro of the AI app card, for people who are not technical (no protocol names). Claude and ChatGPT are names: do not translate.

connect.app.title.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Card title: connect an AI app.

connect.chatgpt.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Product name. Do not translate.

connect.chatgpt.1.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 1 in ChatGPT. Settings and Connectors are names of ChatGPT screens: use the names ChatGPT shows in your language.

connect.chatgpt.2.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 2 in ChatGPT. OAuth stays because ChatGPT's own form shows that word.

connect.chatgpt.3.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 3: allow the access in Ruum.

connect.claudeCode.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Product name. Do not translate.

connect.claudeCode.command.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Accessible name of the command box for Claude Code.

connect.claudeCode.intro.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. How to add Ruum to Claude Code. "/mcp" and "ruum" are typed literally: do not translate. Keep "ruum" in quotation marks (in Estonian it would otherwise read as "a space").

connect.claudeDesktop.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Product name. Do not translate.

connect.claudeDesktop.1.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 1 in Claude Desktop. Use the names Claude shows in your language.

connect.claudeDesktop.2.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 2 in Claude Desktop.

connect.claudeDesktop.3.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Step 3: connect and allow the access in Ruum.

connect.key.address.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Label of the Ruum server address for the command line tool (CLI).

connect.key.intro.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Intro of the key card. Security advice: exact.

connect.key.title.description: Agents page: cards that explain how to connect an AI app or use a key. Instructions: short steps, exact names of buttons in other products. Card title: use a key in a script or the CLI.

consent.acts.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Body: what the app can do. {name} is your name. <b> marks bold text: keep the tags.

consent.agent.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Label: the agent the app acts as.

consent.agent.choose.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Legend: choose an agent.

consent.agent.existing.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Option: use an agent you already have.

consent.agent.existing.label.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Label of the existing agent picker.

consent.agent.name.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Label of the new agent name field.

consent.agent.new.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Option: create a new agent.

consent.agent.option.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. An agent in the picker: {name} and its role {role}.

consent.allow.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Button: allow the connection.

consent.back.can.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Where the app can return after sign-in: one of its addresses {back}, maybe also addresses that are not valid. The selects choose the sentence.

consent.back.will.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Where the app returns after you allow it: {back}, or an address that is not valid.

consent.deny.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Button: do not allow the connection.

consent.done.text.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Done text: you can go back to the app {app}.

consent.done.title.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Done title: the app is connected.

consent.ended.text.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Text when the request ended: start again from the app.

consent.ended.title.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Title when the request ended.

consent.folderFirst.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. consent.from.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Fact: the app says it is from {from} (an address Ruum did not check).

consent.noName.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Warning when Ruum cannot show the app name.

consent.summary.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. The access summary as a sentence: {summary} plus the full stop.

consent.title.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Screen title: the app {app} wants to connect to Ruum.

consent.unchecked.description: OAuth consent screen: an AI app asks to connect to Ruum as an agent for you. Security screen: calm and exact, no jokes. Warning: Ruum cannot check the name or address of the app.

error.cancelled.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A request was cancelled (for example you closed the dialog).

error.class_read_required.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A database change touches personal or secret data you cannot see.

error.conflict.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The item changed while you worked on it.

error.database_not_ready.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The database is still being set up or restored.

error.database_too_large.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The database is too large for a branch; a branch with tables only works.

error.details.code.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Line in the Details disclosure: the error {code} (a snake_case code, do not translate) and the HTTP {status} number.

error.idempotency_key_reused.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Ruum is still working on the same request.

error.internal.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Unknown server error; the code below helps support.

error.migration_failed.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A migration (a change to the tables of a database) failed, and nothing changed.

error.name_taken.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. An item with this name is already in the folder.

error.name_taken.named.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The same, with the name {name}.

error.network.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Ruum could not reach the server or the request failed on the way.

error.not_found.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The item is not there any more.

error.not_implemented.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The feature is not available yet.

error.payload_too_large.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The file is larger than the plan allows; the select uses the name when Ruum has it.

error.permission_denied.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. You do not have access; the select names the space when known.

error.plan_limit_reached.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A limit of the plan is reached; the select names members, agents or another limit. Only an admin can change the plan.

error.query_failed.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The database could not run the query.

error.quota_exceeded.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The space is full. Items in the trash still count, so the way out is to empty the trash or delete items for good. Do not use the word for "space" (a personal or team space) for free storage.

error.rate_limited.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Too many requests at once. A light tone is fine here: nothing is lost.

error.read_only_query.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The query changes data but the console is in read-only mode. "Can change data" is the name of the mode switch: use its translation.

error.scope_exceeded.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The agent does not have access to do this.

error.statement_not_allowed.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Ruum does not run this kind of query. WHERE and LIMIT-like SQL words are not in this message.

error.statement_timeout.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The query ran too long and Ruum stopped it. WHERE and LIMIT are SQL keywords: do not translate.

error.try_again.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A temporary problem.

error.unauthenticated.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. The session ended; sign in again.

error.upload_incomplete.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. A file did not upload completely; the select uses the name when Ruum has it.

error.user_required.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Only a person can do this, not an agent or a link.

error.validation_failed.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Something in a form is not right; the fields are marked.

error.version_mismatch.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. Someone else changed the item a moment ago.

error.write_grant_required.description: Error note for people, shown where the problem is (field, row, dialog). It maps an API error code. Calm and exact: say what happened, then what to do. No jokes, no blame. An agent needs write access to change the database.
